Why Techjays, Why Now

AI is the product, not a pitch deck.

01

What You’ll Gain

What you can expect from us

We’re not just offering you a job. We’re offering you a place to build, belong, and become the best version of yourself.

01

Clear career growth

Defined levels, honest reviews, and a path you can actually see. Structured performance conversations on a regular cadence, with promotion criteria written down and shared, not decided behind a closed door.

02

Mentorship that's real

Every new joiner is paired with a buddy for their first 90 days and a mentor for the long run. Code reviews are teaching moments. Questions are expected, not tolerated.

03

Trust, autonomy and support

We hand you the outcome and the room to reach it. You'll have the freedom to own your work, backed by people who step in when you need them — and step back when you don't.

04

Meaningful work with real impact

Every project has a customer on the other end. You'll know who uses what you built, and what it changed for them.

05

Recognition that matters

We celebrate excellence out loud. Your contributions are seen, credited, and rewarded by the people who saw you do the work.

Life at Techjays

How we actually work, day to day.

How you show up matters just as much as what you deliver. This is what our culture actually looks like, day to day.

What we expect from you

01

Take full ownership

Own your work and your outcomes completely. Be accountable for results, not just tasks.

02

Communicate openly

Share ideas, concerns and feedback early. Clear communication builds trust and prevents the surprises nobody wants.

03

Stay curious and learn

Ask. Explore. Understand before assuming. Keep developing your craft and your judgment.

04

Collaborate with intent

Work together purposefully. Share what you know, support your teammates, and build each other up.

05

Work in pull mode

Take initiative and pull opportunities toward you. Be proactive in seeking challenges rather than waiting for direction.

Our work environment

01

Small teams, short lines.

Most projects run with a handful of people. Your lead knows your work because they read your pull requests, not because they read a status report. Standups are short. Meetings need a reason.

02

In the office, in the room.

Our clients span time zones, so we write decisions down and keep them easy to find. But the way we work day to day is in person walk over, ask the question, unblock the person next to you.

03

AI as a teammate, used responsibly.

We build AI and we work with AI. Every engineer here has modern tooling and is expected to use it well which means understanding what it produced, owning the output, and never shipping something you can't explain.

04

A culture that cares.

Care, inclusion and support aren't posters on a wall. They show up in how we handle a bad week, how we onboard someone new, and how we talk to each other when a release goes sideways.

Our offices

Two cities, one team: Menlo Park and Coimbatore.

Internships & Early Careers

Starting out? Start here.

We hire interns and fresh graduates because we’d rather grow engineers than only rent them. If you’re early in your career, you’ll get real project work not a sandbox exercise that gets deleted at the end of the term.

What you'll do

Join a live project team from week one. Ship code through the same review, QA and release process as everyone else's, on work that reaches production.

What you'll get

A structured program with a named mentor, weekly feedback, and a clear view of what full time conversion requires. Strong performers are considered for offers.

Who we're looking for

Curiosity we can't teach. Fundamentals you've actually practised, not just listed. And evidence you've built something, anywhere - a side project, an open source contribution, a hackathon, or a college project you took further than the syllabus required.
